waitlist-thanks.head.meta-content1: Thank you for joining the OpenWalkieTalkie hardware waitlist.
waitlist-thanks.content.p2: We'll email you when OpenWalkieTalkie is available to buy. If you already joined, you're still on the same list.
waitlist-thanks.content.p3: No payment or commitment is required. Pricing and shipping dates will be announced when they're ready.
waitlist-thanks.content.p5: You can leave the list anytime by emailing privacy@cohdl.ai. Read our Privacy Policy.
